parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table. Join substrate compound records via metabolism.substrate_record_id to compound_records.record_id, then join compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Extract substrate_compound_name from compound_records.compound_name. Retrieve parent_compound_name by joining molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to parent_molregno, then joining molecule_dictionary on pref_name. Include met_conversion and pathway_key from the metabolism table. Do not deduplicate rows. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, and pathway_key.
